status

status_d

user_input

min(dir()) == “status”（字典序最小）

vars().get(min(dir())) 拿到 status

status 是一个列表，内容是 [False]

pop() 取出 False

~False == -1（真值）

append() 回去，status 变为真值，触发成功分支

Z_call1: gen_arity=4, has_subscript=True

myalgodefu32(x: int)-> int: returnx &0xFFFFFFFFdefMX(y: int, z: int, sum_: int, k, p: int, e: int)-> int: return( (((z >>5) ^ (y >>2)) + ((y <<3) ^ (z <<4))) ^ ((sum_ ^ y) + (k[(p &3) ^ e] ^ z)) )defbtea_encrypt(v: list, n: int, k)-> bool: ifn <=1: returnFalse DELTA =1163219540 y = v[0] z = v[n -1] sum_ =0 q =6+52// n whileq >0: q -=1 sum_ = u32(sum_ + DELTA) e = (sum_ >>2) &3 forpinrange(n -1): y = v[p +1] v[p] = u32(v[p] + MX(y, z, sum_, k, p, e)) z = v[p] y = v[0] v[n -1] = u32(v[n -1] + MX(y, z, sum_, k, n -1, e)) z = v[n -1] returnTruedefbtea_decrypt(v: list, n: int, k)-> bool: ifn <=1: returnFalse DELTA =1163219540 q =6+52// n sum_ = u32(q * DELTA) whilesum_ !=0: e = (sum_ >>2) &3 # reverse order update forpinrange(n -1,0,-1): z = v[p -1] y = v[p] v[p] = u32(v[p] - MX(y, z, sum_, k, p, e)) # p = 0 z = v[n -1] y = v[0] v[0] = u32(v[0] - MX(y, z, sum_, k,0, e)) sum_ = u32(sum_ - DELTA) returnTruedefbtea(v: list, n: int, k)-> bool: returnbtea_encrypt(v, n, k)
